item.title: Houthis threaten "painful" response if U.S. joins Saudi offensive
item.description: As Trump mulls joining Saudi Arabia in attacking the Houthis, the Iran-backed group is threatening a "painful" response.

item.title: Hurricane Simon lashes Mexico's Pacific coast, pounds resorts and towns
item.description: Although Simon weakened on Monday, the hurricane continued to pound vulnerable parts of Mexico's Pacific coast.

item.title: Selma Blair arrested after allegedly biting flight attendant
item.description: Actress Selma Blair was arrested after an incident on board a Delta Air Lines flight from Los Angeles to John F. Kennedy International Airport Sunday night.

item.title: Talarico was at home in Texas during campaign trail absence, photos indicate
item.description: James Talarico's campaign shared security camera footage with CBS News that appears to show him at his home in Texas for the first eight days of this month — pushing back on claims that Talarico was hiding the reasons for his disappearance.

item.title: RJ Mitte, "Breaking Bad" actor, dies at 34
item.description: RJ Mitte rose to fame playing Walter White Jr. on the hit series "Breaking Bad."

item.title: Meta unveils new AI models to challenge rivals
item.description: Meta has unveiled new artificial intelligence models it says can compete with the industry's leading systems. Bloomberg tech reporter Riley Griffin joins CBS News with more.

item.title: Will Trump's Russia diesel deal actually bring down prices?
item.description: President Trump said Friday on Truth Social that Russia will "immediately supply" more than 300,000 tons of diesel to global markets, an additional 500,000 tons in November, and 1 million tons "immediately thereafter." Patrick De Haan, head of petroleum analysis at GasBuddy, joins CBS News to discuss the effect that might have on prices.

item.title: What we know about Selma Blair's arrest after allegedly attacking flight attendants
item.description: Actor Selma Blair was arrested over the weekend after allegedly attacking flight attendants during a cross-country flight. CBS News' Kris Van Cleave has more.

item.title: Kelly Clarkson feud with New York store goes viral
item.description: Singer Kelly Clarkson took to social media this weekend to share her experience with a store called Art of Play, claiming the staff looked at her as if she couldn't afford a $15,000 item. The toy store responded, saying Clarkson had tried to buy a singing and dancing bird that wasn't for sale. Clarkson then responded, saying that wasn't true and posting a grainy photo that apparently shows the item hanging on the wall with a price tag next to it. SiriusXM radio host Lamar Dawson joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Inside the Houthis' power as Trump considers strikes after attacks on Saudi Arabia
item.description: The main international airport in Riyadh remains closed after Houthi forces fired a barrage of missiles at the main terminal, causing massive damage and killing at least 13 people over the weekend. Saudi Arabia's government has vowed to retaliate and now wants the U.S. to join in. Gregory Gause, associate fellow at the Middle East Institute, joins CBS News to discuss the level of power the Houthis hold in the Middle East.

item.title: Man killed by tiger after entering enclosure at U.K. wildlife park
item.description: The incident occurred at the Yorkshire Wildlife Park near the city of Doncaster, police said.

item.title: Michigan homecoming game pits kids versus parents after opposing school can't field team
item.description: It was just two days before homecoming when Shepherd High School, in rural Michigan, found out their opponents had too many injuries and call-outs to field a team that Friday. That's when a new kind of homecoming game started taking shape. Tony Dokoupil reports.

item.title: Witnesses describe moment man was killed by tiger at U.K. wildlife park
item.description: At a wildlife park in Northern England on Saturday, a man jumped over a barrier, into the enclosure of a 5-year-old Siberian tiger, and did not make it back out alive. Mark Strassmann has more.

item.title: Pope Leo to go to hospital Tuesday for lung nodule surgery
item.description: Pope Leo XIV​ revealed the discovery of a lung nodule during his Sunday noon prayer and said he was following doctors' advice to have it removed.

item.title: Pope Leo to be admitted to hospital Tuesday ahead of lung surgery
item.description: Catholics around the world are praying for the health of Pope Leo, who revealed over the weekend that he needs to undergo lung surgery. Chris Livesay has the latest from Rome.

item.title: House Speaker Mike Johnson voices opposition to livestreamed execution planned by Hegseth
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson was asked by CBS News chief Washington analyst Robert Costa about Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's plan to live stream the firing squad execution of the Fort Hood shooter. Speaker Johnson, joining with other prominent Republicans, is against that idea.

item.title: Trump considering strikes against Houthis in Yemen after attacks on Saudi Arabia
item.description: President Trump is considering launching U.S. military strikes against the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen, following a wave of attacks on Saudi Arabia. Holly Williams reports.

item.title: Rep. Omar's D.C. home searched by DHS investigators
item.description: Sources say the investigation centers on Rep. Ilhan Omar's immigration documents, involving paperwork filled out by her late father when she was a child.

item.title: Ilhan Omar raid concerns immigration paperwork from when she was a child, sources say
item.description: Federal agents searched Rep. Ilhan Omar's Washington, D.C., home Monday morning. Sources tell CBS News a yearslong probe into Omar involves immigration paperwork that was completed by her late father when she was a child. Omar, a U.S. citizen, and the first Somali American in Congress, called the search "an attempt to target political enemies." Nicole Sganga reports.

item.title: Americans on both coasts cleaning up after severe weekend weather
item.description: Recovery efforts are underway after destructive storms over the weekend in both the Southeast, where a hurricane killed at least four people, and the Southwest, where a tropical storm caused widespread damage. Jonathan Vigliotti reports.

item.title: Selma Blair allegedly hit 1 flight attendant, bit another on flight before arrest
item.description: Actress Selma Blair was arrested after a cross-country flight over the weekend. She's accused of hitting one flight attendant, biting another and then trying to open a plane door. Kris Van Cleave reports.

item.title: Rider falls to their death from roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia
item.description: A roller coaster rider fell to their death Monday from The Goliath, a 200-foot-tall "hyper-coaster" designed to create up to 4 g's of force, a sensation similar to flying a fighter jet. Skyler Henry reports.

item.title: Philadelphia bus standoff ends after suspected gunman shoots self, police say
item.description: Philadelphia police say a gunman suspected of killing two women is dead, appearing to have shot himself after an hours-long standoff aboard a transit bus on Monday. CBS News correspondent Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Data center boom puts GOP in a bind before midterms
item.description: Cleanview Research found 75% of data centers being built and 80% of data centers in the planning stage are in predominantly GOP states, as public opposition to data centers grows.

item.title: Emergency help for Christa Pike was delayed, 911 calls show
item.description: It took about half an hour after the first 911 call about Christa Pike's botched execution for prison officials to affirm the emergency was legitimate, the calls show.

item.title: 10/12: CBS Evening News
item.description: Rider falls to their death from roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia; early details on Selma Blair's flight arrest.

item.title: Michigan GOP governor hopeful John James says "Trump doesn't speak for" state amid Canada tariff war
item.description: Republican Rep. John James, the Republican nominee for governor in Michigan, is running behind Democrat Jocelyn Benson in the polls as tariffs and the war with Iran dominate the race. James joins "The Takeout" to discuss the state of his campaign.

item.title: 10/12: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine collapses; federal immigration agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's home.

item.title: Would access to Russian diesel help drive down U.S. prices?
item.description: Average U.S. diesel prices remain stuck above $6 a gallon, raising fuel costs in trucking, agriculture and construction.

item.title: 8 killed, including 2 children, in mass shooting in Erie; suspect also dead
item.description: Eight people, including two children, were killed Friday in a mass shooting in a residential area of Erie, Pennsylvania, authorities said. The suspected gunman is also dead.
